purpose: Clean-directory rebuild of the Lean sources for v1.7.1 (the v1.7.0 sources moved to Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1)
procedure: Same procedure as logs/clean-replay-v1.7.0-receipt.json: fresh directory, sources copied from the release tree (here the v1.7.1 candidate of lean/: git 9c00fe8 plus the changes in CHANGES-v1.7.1.md), shared Lake package cache for Mathlib and its dependencies at the pinned revisions (every package HEAD equal to lake-manifest.json, no tracked changes), fresh .lake/build.

Because Research.CirculantQ3 needs 21-28 GB on Lean 4.34.1 (21.7 GB here), it was built alone first, holding both Lean lock slots: `/usr/bin/time -l lake build Research.CirculantQ3` (log: clean-replay-v1.7.1-build-circulantq3.log); its leanchecker run also held both slots.
`/usr/bin/time -l lake build` (log: clean-replay-v1.7.1-build.log): 8976 jobs, exit 0; CirculantQ3 is replayed from the first step.
Eleven audit files run with `lake env lean` (logs: clean-replay-v1.7.1-audit-*.log), all exit 0; their output is textually identical to the v1.7.0 audit logs.

`lake build` of the eleven audit modules (log: clean-replay-v1.7.1-build-audit-modules.log), then `lake env leanchecker <Module>` for every module: the 51 proof modules and the 11 audit modules, one module per run (log: clean-replay-v1.7.1-leanchecker.log). The root module Research is not passed to leanchecker, which would read it as a prefix and check everything at once; it defines no constants.
`shasum -a 256` of sources and configuration (logs/lean-sources-sha256.txt, 66 files), checked in the replay directory and against the candidate lean/ folder (66 of 66 OK each).

LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 for every run: Lake ran at most two build jobs at a time and leanchecker at most two worker threads per run (two runs at a time). The `lean` compiler processes do not read LEAN_NUM_THREADS (their thread pool defaults to the hardware thread count unless `-j` is given), so the `lake build` step averaged 3.6 cores but peaked at about 15 in ps samples; see "cpu".
trusted_cache: Shared Lake package cache for Mathlib and its dependencies at the pinned revisions (Mathlib .olean files from `lake exe cache get`, not rebuilt). No build output of this project was copied.

axiom_audit.note: Every printed axiom list is a subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; Carenini.H3_bipartite depends on no axioms. Same counts as v1.7.0 (119 + 1 lines in the build log, 392 in the audit logs).

leanchecker.modules: 51 proof modules (CirculantQ3 under both lock slots) and 11 audit modules

forbidden_tokens.note: comment hits: "no `native_decide`" in Carenini.lean:29 and HKOTriameter.lean:29, "axiom audit" in ICGEqualParityBAudit.lean:5; the plain grep also matches "external" in comments of CirculantQ3.lean:6 and Oeis389472Mod3.lean:8

statement_comparison.method: Every constant of the 51 released modules printed with pp.all (all implicit arguments, universes, no notation), on Lean 4.33.1 / Mathlib 0df444a3 from the v1.7.0 sources and on Lean 4.34.1 / Mathlib d13f23b7 from these sources (built in this replay), then compared; once more with type-class instance arguments hidden (pp.instances false).
explanation: Differences that disappear when instance arguments are hidden: the same type-class instances reached through different paths in Mathlib d13f23b7 (for example Semiring (ZMod 3) via Semifield.toCommSemiring instead of Semifield.toDivisionSemiring); definitionally equal.
HannaA184894.a and five lemmas of HannaA184894: Polynomial.coeff now returns the coefficient finsupp (R[X] → ℕ →₀ R) and is applied through the finsupp coercion; p.coeff n is the same value.
SwitchingDiam4.no_eigenvalue_root_cubic: the Semiring ℝ instance inside algebraMap ℚ ℝ is now Ring.toSemiring (was DivisionSemiring.toSemiring); definitionally equal.
Auxiliary constants: HannaA184894.a.eq_1 (follows from the coeff change) and the notation helpers of the three edited local notation lines.
The PowerSeries.derivative edits leave every theorem and definition of HannaA301933, HannaA361047 and Oeis389472Mod3 identical.
statement_comparison.anchors: <project>/work/lean-upgrade-v434/stmt-compare/Anchors.lean (12 examples, compiled unchanged on both toolchains) pins down: the coefficient formula of PowerSeries.derivative; p.coeff n = p.toFinsupp.coeff n for polynomials; the MvPolynomial analogue; rfl between the old and new instance terms.

changes.summary: lean-toolchain, lakefile.toml (Mathlib rev), lake-manifest.json; 13 lines in Research/HannaA301933.lean, Research/HannaA361047.lean, Research/Oeis389472Mod3.lean (PowerSeries.derivative: ring argument now passed by name). The other 60 .lean files are byte-identical to v1.7.0.

cpu.note: ps %CPU is a decaying average; 100 = one core. Limit asked for: 6 threads. Kept on average in every step, but not at the peaks of `lake build` and of the audit files, where `lean` used its default thread pool.

locks: Taken and released only with <project>/work/tools/leanlock.sh: slots A and B together for the CirculantQ3 build and leanchecker (2026-09-27T20:56:04Z to 2026-09-27T21:14:41Z), one slot for the rest (2026-09-27T21:14:52Z to 2026-09-27T21:29:56Z).
